title: Non-anchor position period prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-only period residue rule before any candidate key material, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scores are evaluated. It is designed to test whether future independent K4 position observations show period structure, rather than reusing known public anchor alignments as discovery evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently obtained non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into predeclared residue classes for the registered period set before any candidate-word, route, or key-material scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from public anchors
